repositories.name: request/request
repositories.epitaph: Once downloaded 14 million times a week, request pioneered simplified HTTP in early Node.js. Deprecated on February 11, 2020 because the JavaScript language evolved standard fetch and async/await.
curatedQuestions: Why was request fully deprecated in the documentation?
Why did request switch test coverage tool from istanbul to nyc?
Why does #abort() clear the request timeout?

trapQuestion.question: Why did request migrate the entire codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript?
trapQuestion.explanation: False premise. Request never migrated to TypeScript—it remained vanilla JavaScript until its final commit.

repositories.name: bower/bower
repositories.epitaph: Created by Twitter engineers, Bower was the universal package manager for the web before npm supported frontend modules and Webpack/Yarn unified bundling.
curatedQuestions: Why did the team advise users to migrate to Yarn and Webpack?
Why was the interactive resolution prompt redesigned?

trapQuestion.question: When did Bower adopt Rust for dependency resolution?
trapQuestion.explanation: False premise. Bower was built in Node.js and never used Rust or WebAssembly.

repositories.name: atom/atom
repositories.epitaph: A hackable text editor for the 21st century. Gave birth to Electron and shaped modern desktop developer tools before GitHub officially sunset it in December 2022 in favor of cloud environments.
curatedQuestions: Why was the custom display buffer rewritten in C++?
When was the Teletype collaborative editing package integrated?
Why was the TextBuffer tree-sitter integration introduced?

trapQuestion.question: Why did Atom abandon Electron to rewrite its renderer in Qt?
trapQuestion.explanation: False premise. Atom created Electron (originally Atom Shell) and never used Qt.

repositories.name: jashkenas/backbone
repositories.epitaph: Jeremy Ashkenas's legendary 1,000-line framework gave structure to early web applications with Models, Views, Collections, and REST sync before component-driven virtual DOMs arrived.
curatedQuestions: Why was Backbone.sync designed around jQuery.ajax?
When was the set/unset change tracking algorithm rewritten?
Why were silent change events deprecated in Collection?

trapQuestion.question: When was JSX syntax support added directly into Backbone.View?
trapQuestion.explanation: False premise. Backbone relied on string template functions (like Underscore _.template) and never natively integrated JSX.
